subject: CloudCon booth: visibility passport stickers + power-share slot
messages:
From: Mike Reynolds <mike@expo-services.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudCon booth: visibility passport stickers + power-share slot

Hi Rishi / Marissa / Stephanie,

Quick note from the venue side — two items that will affect booth setup and collateral:

1) Visibility passport: CloudCon is running a "passport" program this year where attendees collect stickers or scans from sponsor booths for a prize drawing. We can provide the attendee scanning kiosks, but we need your sticker die-lines + final art by next Tuesday (Sept 5) to include in the expo pickup bags.

2) Power sharing: The island exhibits in Hall B are on a shared 20A circuit per 3 booths. You requested 2 dedicated outlets during layout review; facilities has flagged that the booth footprint falls into the shared power cluster. We can either: (A) provide a split power agreement (one booth billed for the dedicated drop, with a formal power-sharing addendum signed), or (B) pull an extra run but that requires an additional late fee and lead time.

Attached: sticker-art-proof_v2.pdf (proof, includes bleed + die lines), power-layout-drawings.png (venue layout with circuit mapping).

Can you confirm which route you prefer for power, and whether PrintPlus should print the passport stickers? If you want PrintPlus to handle stickers, cc them and I'll route the art file.

Best,
Mike
--
Mike Reynolds
Operations Manager, Expo Services
expo-services.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Reynolds <mike@expo-services.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, PrintPlus Co. <printplus@vendors.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudCon booth: visibility passport stickers + power-share slot

Thanks Mike — this is helpful. A few quick decisions from our side:

- Passport stickers: Yes, please route to PrintPlus and cc our onsite lead. We want two sticker variants: 1) standard 2in x 2in square for kiosks, 2) a 0.75in round sticker for giveaway packs. PrintPlus, can you confirm production lead time if we sign off on files by Sept 5?

- Power: We prefer option (A) — sign the split power addendum and have Redwood billed for the dedicated drop. Can you send the power-sharing addendum or DocuSign link and confirm the exact outlets and whether a single 20A will be sufficient for our demo gear plus two charging stations? Our expected max draw: demo rack ~6A, 2x charging stations ~8A peak.

- Standby kits: Marissa / Stephanie, please advise if we should bring the standard standby kit (spare power strips, gaffer tape, labeled cable ties, 1st aid) or request venue kit. I recommend we bring ours given previous venue shortages.

Next steps: Mike — send the addendum link and a confirmed outlet map, PrintPlus — lead time and preferred file format.

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Mike Reynolds <mike@expo-services.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, PrintPlus Co. <printplus@vendors.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudCon booth: visibility passport stickers + power-share slot

Appreciate the direction, Rishi.

- DocuSign: Sent — https://app.docusign.com/documents/abc123-power-agreement (power allocation addendum). Please have the authorized signatory on your side sign by Sept 6 to avoid the extra pull fee. The addendum outlines that Redwood will be billed for the dedicated drop and covers load balancing responsibilities during the event.

- Outlet map: The attached power-layout-drawings.png shows your booth at grid C4; the shared 20A cluster covers booths C2-C4. If you sign the addendum, facilities will earmark the upstream breaker for your booth and route a labeled run to your island; that will give you effectively one dedicated 20A. For redundancy we recommend bringing one UPS or a small power conditioner.

- PrintPlus: we need a production ETA. PrintPlus, Rishi asked for two sticker variants and 2,000 units of the square sticker plus 500 rounds. Can you confirm receipt of the art and turnaround + shipping to the venue?

Attachments: DocuSign-power-allocation-link.txt (link), power-layout-drawings.png

Regards,
Mike

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Reynolds <mike@expo-services.com>, PrintPlus Co. <printplus@vendors.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudCon booth: visibility passport stickers + power-share slot

Thanks all — quick ops notes from my side:

- Standby kit: we'll bring Redwood Kit A (2x 6ft power strips, 1x 1kVA UPS, spare ethernet, gaffer, cable ties). I'll put it on the crate manifest.

- PrintPlus: we approve print run contingent on file fixes below — please remove crop marks on the round sticker and convert text to outlines. We need stickers at venue by Sept 22 (exhibitor move-in Sept 24). If you can do express shipping to the venue, include crate label: "Redwood Inference | Booth C4 | CloudCon 2028".

- Sign-off & billing: Rishi, I'll authorize the DocuSign once procurement confirms cost center. Stephanie, can you attach the procurement code and confirm billing contact for the power addendum?

Marissa
Sr. Events Manager, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stub: sticker-art-proof_v2.pdf (see Mike's original), DocuSign-power-allocation-link.txt (link to signed envelope placeholder)
